name: Juneau Showhome
lede: In Juneau’s temperate rainforest, a showhome divides its outdoor space into living, dining and grilling zones. The owners chose electric over gas, with Platinum Electric for the grill and matte black Tungsten Electric on the walls.
data: Designer show home – outdoor living, dining and grilling
Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric · Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric, matte black
beats: Set in Juneau’s temperate rainforest, the showhome, designed by Bauer/Clifton Interiors, splits its outdoor space into zones for living, dining and grilling.
In Alaska the designer called outdoor heat close to a necessity. The clients wanted electric rather than propane or natural gas.

A Platinum Electric heater, chosen for its durability, warms the open grilling zone of about 75 sq ft; matte black wall-mounted Tungsten Electric heaters were chosen to read as part of the architecture.
